headline: Saudi Arabia Shuts Down a Key Oil Pipeline After Drone Attack
summary: Saudi Arabia said on Friday it would temporarily shut the key East-West crude oil pipeline after drones coming from Iraq attacked the infrastructure. The move cuts a major route for Saudi crude exports.
why: The East-West pipeline carries Saudi crude from the eastern oilfields to the Red Sea, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz, so disruptions can tighten global oil supply.
why_moved: Saudi Arabia shut the East-West pipeline after drones from Iraq attacked the infrastructure, cutting a key route for crude. Reduced export capacity from a major producer typically pushes oil prices higher.
